Breach.TypeofCareObligationViolation: Insufficient Due Diligence and Risk Analysis

Customers.CustomerSummary: Customer 1 suffered a loss of $7,078 due to Candelario Padilla's recommendations to purchase NT-ETFs without having a sufficient understanding of the risks and features associated with these products. This constitutes a Care Obligation violation under Regulation BI as Candelario Padilla failed to exercise reasonable diligence to understand the potential risks of NT-ETFs, specifically the compounding losses that can occur due to the daily reset function. The customer held NT-ETF positions for an extended period, contrary to the guidance that these products are typically not suitable for retail investors who plan to hold them for more than one trading session.
